description: This file provides date and time utility functions for the Notesnook project, including formatting dates, generating week groups from timestamps, and handling various date/time formats and options.

methods.name: getWeekGroupFromTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a string representing the week range for a given timestamp.

methods.name: getTimeFormat
methods.description: Returns the time format string based on the specified format ('12-hour' or 24-hour).

methods.name: getDayFormat
methods.description: Returns the day format string ('ddd' or 'dddd') based on the specified format.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date according to the provided options, supporting multiple date/time formats and time zones.
